messages:
maria: T-minus 45m until UTC quiet window starts. Quick sync — traffic throttle goes live at T-30, DB migration staged, deploy pin applied. Any blockers?

deploy-bot: automated: PIN SET -> v3.4.2-rc (reason: launch-sundown). command: `deployctl pin --env prod --version v3.4.2-rc` :white_check_mark:

jordan: Ack. Throttle plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% over 5m steps. Will raise to 75% only after 15m of stable metrics. Dashboard: https://dash.re/redwood/rollout/1771

liam: Rollback playbook reminder: if 5xx rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m OR user-visible regressions in key flows, rollback to v3.4.1 immediately. Owners: @maria @sana.

sana: Oncall for rollback/watch. Canary smoke script ready: `./smoke-run.sh --canary`. I'll watch logs and hit the rollback if needed.

qa-lead: Small release-notes tweak: call out embedding behaviour change under "Known Changes". Pushed commit to docs (PR #1423). Please review quickly, want the public note before T-5.

ops-runner: Migration note: adding index on messages(created_at) using pt-online-schema-change with --max-load=Threads_running=25. No table lock expected. I'll keep throttle low. Logs: /var/log/migrations.log

jordan: FYI capacity may jitter when throttle steps. Autoscale policy ready to add +2 GPU nodes at 30% throttle; will trigger if latency > 99th percentile baseline +50ms.

maria: Final checklist: canary metrics ok? @sana confirm. Release notes updated? @qa-lead confirm. DB migration nonblocking? @ops-runner confirm. If all green we go per schedule. If any spike, unpin + rollback.

sana: Canary green — CPU and latency steady, no increase in error budget. :thumbsup:

maria: Great. Launch in T-15. Reminder: no ad-hoc hotfixes during quiet window unless emergency — escalate on #release-war-room with a clear rollback plan.

deploy-bot: scheduled job queued: traffic-throttle (run_at=1771234575) run-id=0x9f3. Will execute pin+throttle sequence.

ops-runner: Watching migration logs now: `tail -f /var/log/migrations.log`. Will report any DDL lock or long-running queries.

maria: Thanks all — I'll post final GO at T-5 unless flagged.
